Home / Save locations

Game Save File Locations — 100 Games

Every game hides its saves somewhere different. This is the folder map Checkpoint64 ships with — the exact save path for every supported game, per platform. Open a game for the full breakdown, or just install the app: it already knows all of these.

Looking for the deep-dive backup guides instead? See the per-game backup guides.

  • 7 Days to Die

    %APPDATA%\7DaysToDie\Saves

  • Abiotic Factor

    %LOCALAPPDATA%\AbioticFactor\Saved\SaveGames

  • Alchemy Factory

    %LOCALAPPDATA%\AlchemyFactory\Saved\SaveGames

  • Anno 1800

    %USERPROFILE%\Documents\Anno 1800\accounts

  • ASKA

    %USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\Sand Sailor Studio\Aska\data

  • Astroneer

    %LOCALAPPDATA%\Astro\Saved\SaveGames

  • Baldur's Gate 3

    %LOCALAPPDATA%\Larian Studios\Baldur's Gate 3\PlayerProfiles

  • Bellwright

    %LOCALAPPDATA%\Bellwright\Saved\SaveGames\

  • Big Walk

    %USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\House House\Big Walk\user_data\save_games

  • Black Mesa

    {STEAM}\steamapps\common\Black Mesa\bms\save

  • Calyx

    %LOCALAPPDATA%\Calyx\Saved

  • Castle Story

    %USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\Castle Story\SaveGames

  • Cemu (Wii U)

    %APPDATA%\Cemu\mlc01\usr\save

  • Cities: Skylines

    %LOCALAPPDATA%\Colossal Order\Cities_Skylines\Saves

  • Civilization VI

    %USERPROFILE%\Documents\My Games\Sid Meier's Civilization VI\Saves

  • Core Keeper

    %USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\Pugstorm\Core Keeper\Steam

  • Crisis: The Third Way

    %USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\Andrealphus\Third Crisis

  • Crusader Kings III

    %USERPROFILE%\Documents\Paradox Interactive\Crusader Kings III\save games

  • Cult of the Lamb

    %USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\Massive Monster\Cult Of The Lamb\saves

  • Cyberpunk 2077

    %USERPROFILE%\Saved Games\CD Projekt Red\Cyberpunk 2077

  • Dark Souls III

    %APPDATA%\DarkSoulsIII

  • Dave the Diver
